monitoring.scope: read-only PostgreSQL processing_job and Linux procfs sampling
monitoring.final_state: v1 backfill paused by operator for v2 rollout; no processes or leases remained

measured.memory_note: PSS is the physical-memory measure used because forked workers share large copy-on-write banks; summed RSS substantially double-counts those pages.

duplicate_lease.interpretation: Both leases named the same session. The store writer lock prevented two independent published analyses; the process group still temporarily occupied an extra queue slot.

assessment.result: No retry, lease expiry, worker swap, or memory-pressure failure was observed before the controlled pause. The densest completed measured job used 8.452 GiB PSS and finished both priors within 6.68 minutes, below the pre-rollout 12-14 GiB and 5-7 minute conservative bounds.
limitations: Procfs was sampled every 15 seconds, so short peaks may be missed.
Observed process spans are censored for processes already active at the first sample and include pipeline work around the numerical search.
The controlled pause ended the observation window; pending jobs are not failures.
The input policy has no hard cap on total observations or tracks, so the 165-session inventory maximum is empirical rather than a contract bound.
